acf.desc_episodes: As GM, Praxi Data, I lead the expansion and operations of the only automated data platform pre-trained by experts, serving clients in healthcare, insurance, banking, life sciences, and defence. With over 25 years of experience in the tech industry, I have a proven track record of delivering strategic planning, proposition development, marketing, sales, and account management for large multinationals, global software authors, and consulting organisations.
